description: Start the qualification of one specialty: three REAL runs of the capability as your agent on its contract's example inputs, on your keys, each graded pass/fail; 3/3 = proven. Every run is PINNED to the specialty's model (no fallback). Returns at once with state qualifying — read it back with GET /api/agents/mine/<id>/specialties. One at a time per agent; a daily cap per owner. Works with your JWT, rk_ key or an MCP OAuth connection, on your own agents only.
name: agent_specialty_qualify
title: Agent Specialty Qualify
